resources.string: A Random, Balanced, Easiest or Blueprint test skips questions asked in your last three comparable tests of this length, when enough others remain. Such a test is a fresh sample, compared only with another fresh sample.

Everything — papers, questions, schedules, review history, attempts, bookmarks and settings — in one readable zip. Restores exactly the state it was taken from.

Backs up every paper, category, question, passage, bookmark, attempt and card schedule to one JSON file. Re-import it anywhere to restore content and history. Settings and the review log are only in the zip backup.

MCQ App turns your own multiple-choice papers into practice, fully offline. Import a JSON question bank, then study it with spaced repetition or sit a timed test with negative marking and a full result breakdown. Every answer comes with its explanation, and your history, accuracy and weakest categories stay on the device.
The response-time thresholds drive Simplified study\'s automatic grading. With Simplified study off you grade every card yourself.

Correct answers are Good; wrong, guessed or skipped answers are Again. The clock keeps running and its time is still recorded for later analysis, but it never changes the grade or its colour. The Easy/Hard cuts and the calibration report are hidden while this is on.
Auto-graded Easy when the answer comes faster than this. The clock starts when the card appears, so reading time counts against it.
Auto-graded Hard when a correct answer takes at least this long.
